newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket - South Africa 3-79 at close v Indian Board side.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - South Africa 3-79 at close v Indian Board side.

text.p: An Indian Board President's XI grabbed three wickets for 74 runs at the close of the opening day of their three-day game against South Africa after being bowled out for 179 by the visitors.

Left-arm spinner Venkatapathy Raju, a one-time regular in the Indian test side, accounted for opener Andrew Hudson and skipper Hansie Cronje in the final session, moving the ball with subtle variation on a slow pitch.

Earlier, medium paceman Fanie De Villiers took five wickets for 46 runs as the home side collapsed for 179. Only ninth man, bowler Salim Ankola with an aggressive 63 with six fours and four sixes brought some respectability to the total.
He came back to took the wicket of Gary Kirsten, caught by P. Krishnakumar for 11.
Scores: Indian Board President's XI 1st innings - 179 all out (Ankola 63, De Villiers 5-46, Klusener 3-38)
South Africa 1st innings 74 for 3 at the close (A. Hudson 39)
